acceptance_basis: User explicitly selected current-day cumulative IEX volume divided by the prior 30 complete trading days' IEX mean volume, raw adjustment, 5x threshold; scanner and replay only.

rules.rvol_numerator: current New York calendar day's observed cumulative IEX dailyBar volume
rules.rvol_denominator: sum of raw IEX daily volumes for exactly the previous 30 calendar-confirmed trading sessions divided by 30
rules.decision_arithmetic: Compare current_volume * 30 >= 5 * sum(history); no rounded ratio threshold
rules.history_completion: next New York midnight has elapsed; not a claim of immutable vendor finality
rules.ranking: descending exact percentage change from prior-session raw IEX daily close, symbol ascending for ties
rules.news: optional preference, unavailable without separately validated evidence
rules.float: optional preference, unavailable without separately validated evidence

discovery.identity_acceptance: every literal catalog symbol requested exactly once; no silently dropped or aliased symbols

time_acceptance.basis: recorded local availability and explicit source timestamps at offline evaluation
time_acceptance.pagination: each query's token chain must terminate with no next token
time_acceptance.revisions: new observations available only after their own recorded receipt/processing clocks
time_acceptance.scope: observed-as-of offline screening, not a simultaneous or fresh executable market snapshot
